title: Add a read-only viewer role
objective: Library owners want to give some people read-only access. Add a `viewer` role beside `owner` and `editor`. A viewer can see the library page, list, search and read documents (API and document page), and nothing else: creating, renaming, archiving or deleting documents, seeing, creating, changing or removing links, the activity page and analytics API, the audit export and managing members all answer 403 `forbidden` to a viewer and change nothing; the document page shows a viewer no links and no activity link. Owners manage members: `POST /api/libraries/:id/members` with `{ email, role }` adds an existing user (201 `{ member: { userId, libraryId, role } }`; 400 `invalid_role`, `unknown_user` or `already_member`), and `PATCH /api/libraries/:id/members/:userId` with `{ role }` changes a role (404 if not a member; 400 `last_owner` when it would leave the library without an owner). Only owners may do either (403 for other members, 404 for outsiders). Both write audit entries (`member.added`, `member.role_changed`). Editors and outsiders behave exactly as today. Add tests, including the refusals.
acceptance: Library owners add members with a role, with validation, permission and audit
A viewer reads the library, its documents and search
A viewer gets 403 from every changing, link, activity, audit and member route, nothing is written, and the document page shows no links
Owners change roles with validation and audit; the last owner cannot be demoted
plan_summary: access gains canEdit/editableDocument; document, link, analytics and sharing paths refuse viewers; a members route module with add and change-role; the document view hides links from viewers; tests.
